findings.finding: Five CSVs are cumulative append containers, not isolated timeframe files.
Trade logs are incomplete or snapshot-fragmented; ID ranges contain large gaps.
PDFs claim 2438 trades, while only 325 target-candidate rows exist and snapshots do not reconcile.
Schema is positional, minified, and inconsistent at 20 versus 21 columns.
4h trade 16 and 1D trade 17 are semantically shifted zero-PnL rows.
Timezone, exchange/feed, date range, and complete Strategy Properties are absent.
One 1h row is Open and unrealized.
Raw nulls are expected sparse direction markers; unexpected NaN count is zero.
Default pandas parsing fails on 56 mixed-format 1D-container timestamp cells; explicit parsing succeeds.
Both PDFs include parameter-change/live-allocation recommendations incompatible with the immutable-strategy audit scope.

recommended_preprocessing_strategy.action: Freeze Pine hash, symbol/feed, timezone, date range, and every Strategy Property; regenerate equivalence evidence.
Resolve 40 USD metadata versus Pine initial_capital=10000 before calculating returns.
Re-export one complete isolated List of Trades file per timeframe with stable semantic headers.
If re-export is impossible, split at trade-ID resets and verify timeframe via elapsed_minutes/bars; use the last matching segment only provisionally.
Map a canonical derived schema and quarantine the two shifted zero-PnL rows; preserve raw text and source row.
Normalize U+2212 minus, commas, percentages, and U+202F K suffix without writing raw files.
Parse both timestamp formats explicitly and attach the documented timezone; never infer timezone.
Use snapshot_id+timeframe+trade_id+entry+exit+side as a composite key; trade_id alone is not unique.
Separate Open rows from realized trades.
Reconcile directional PnL, PnL percentage, cumulative PnL, ID coverage, and PDF/CSV snapshot identity.
Add HTF bias, minimum entry score, preset, costs, feed, date range, and Pine hash to future experiment metadata.

analysis_acceptance_gates: Current Pine hash matches equivalence evidence.
Initial capital and all Strategy Properties are reconciled.
Every timeframe has a complete isolated log or documented sampling design.
No semantically shifted rows remain unresolved.
Timezone, exchange/feed, and date range are frozen.
PDF totals reconcile to the same snapshot or are excluded as evidence.
